scripts.build: node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && npm run build:agent && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-no-ui-emoji.mjs && node scripts/check-source-hygiene.mjs && node ../scripts/check-docs-links.mjs && node ../scripts/check-docs-consistency.mjs && node ../scripts/check-api-docs.mjs
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && node scripts/build-agent.mjs && node scripts/tauri-build.mjs

scripts.cap:build:android:lite: node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && node scripts/check-lite-identity.mjs && node scripts/build-lite.mjs --sync android
scripts.cap:build:ios:lite: node scripts/check-api-url.mjs && node scripts/check-lite-identity.mjs && node scripts/build-lite.mjs --sync ios

scripts.cap:build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
